biggest_catch: Business-only and location-locked: the business must be located in MD, PA, DE, WV, VA, or DC, and you must maintain a $5,000 average daily balance for the first two monthly statement cycles.
catches: Open a new eligible SECU business checking account between July 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026 using promo code BB350 (enter during online application or provide in-branch).
Maintain an average daily balance of $5,000 for the first two monthly statement cycles.

Eligible accounts: free business checking, interest-earning business checking, or nonprofit checking. A business share savings account is required ($10 minimum to open; $100 minimum to open the business checking) — these are opening deposits, not fees.
Existing or previous business members must not have had one of the eligible business checking account types within the last 24 months; not available to estates.
Business must be located in MD, PA, DE, WV, VA, or the District of Columbia.

SECU credits the $350 bonus to the new business checking account within 90 days of meeting the qualifying conditions; business membership and accounts must be in good standing and actively enrolled in mobile and online banking at payout.

One bonus per business membership (including related businesses/subsidiaries); cannot be combined with any other offer; promotional period subject to change at any time without notice; SECU's determination of eligibility is final.
Bonuses are miscellaneous income and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC; taxes are the member's responsibility.
